definitions.cont: nu(r, d) m(d) > B_alpha strict, as in the statement of Theorem qrhcomp; T_0 = sup of the failing heights
definitions.kzero: nu(r, d) >= k with k = floor(B_alpha/m(d)) + 1 (the window holds at least k zeros); T_0 = sup of the failing heights
definitions.int: nu(r, d) > k - 1 (the zero count is an integer at least nu, so at least k); T_0 = sup of the failing heights

grid.r_range: from d + 30 to 1e15 (off line), to H - d (on line)
